question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-25:
    -- 25th anniversary of birth_date is on or before 2026-09-25
    -- and 26th anniversary is after 2026-09-25
    (substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25) || substr(c.birth_date, 5, 6) <= '2026-09-25'
    AND (substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 26) || substr(c.birth_date, 5, 6) > '2026-09-25'
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
          OR (
              CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
              AND (
                  CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < 9
                  OR (
                      CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
                      AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 24
                  )
              )
          )
      )
      AND NOT (
          CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26 <= 2026
          OR (
              CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26 = 2026
              AND (
                  CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < 9
                  OR (
                      CAST(substr(birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
                      AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 24
                  )
              )
          )
      )
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (o.date >= c.birth_date AND 
     substr(o.date, 1, 10) >= 
     substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2))
    AND
    (o.date < 
     (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2))
    AND
    (CAST(substr(o.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 25
     OR
     (CAST(substr(o.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 26
      AND 
      CAST(substr(o.date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
      OR
      (CAST(substr(o.date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
       AND
       CAST(substr(o.date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) < CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)))
    AND
    NOT (CAST(substr(o.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 26
         AND
         CAST(substr(o.date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
         AND
         CAST(substr(o.date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER));

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-12-01
    -- Born on 2001-12-01: turns 25 on 2026-12-01 (anniversary is on or before, next after)
    c.birth_date = '2001-12-01'
    OR
    -- General check: completed age 25 on 2026-12-01
    -- 25th anniversary of birth_date <= 2026-12-01 AND 26th anniversary > 2026-12-01
    (date(c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-12-01' AND date(c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-12-01')
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-25'
    OR
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-25'
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) * 10000 +
  CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
  CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER) -
  (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) >= 250000
  AND (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) + 250000 <= (
    CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-25
    (c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
     AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) <= '09-25'
     AND substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) = '2001'
     AND (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) < '09-25' OR (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09-25' AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '25'))
    OR
    (c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
     AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09-25'
     AND substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) = '2000'
     AND (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09-25' OR (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09-25' AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '25')))
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      )
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (2026 - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) = 25
  AND (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)) 
      <= (CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER));
